@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I find your excuse too r______s to believe. It can't possibly be true!
= ridiculous
~詞義 ridiculous（adj.）荒謬的
~原文 I find your excuse too ridiculous to believe. It can't possibly be true!

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The speaker m______ed throughout the whole presentation, so the audience members had a hard time understanding what he was saying.
= mumbled
~詞義 mumble（v.）含糊地說
~原文 The speaker mumbled throughout the whole presentation, so the audience members had a hard time understanding what he was saying.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: David's neighbor plays the violin very poorly, and every evening he has to bear the d______l sound that hurts his ears.
= dreadful
~詞義 dreadful（adj.）可怕的;糟糕的
~原文 David's neighbor plays the violin very poorly, and every evening he has to bear the dreadful sound that hurts his ears.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jay Chou is u______y one of the best-known singers in Taiwan. Almost everyone has heard at least one of his songs.
= undoubtedly
~詞義 undoubtedly（adv.）毫無疑問地
~原文 Jay Chou is undoubtedly one of the best-known singers in Taiwan. Almost everyone has heard at least one of his songs.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Palm trees t______e in tropical climates; they don't grow well in cold places.
= thrive
~詞義 thrive（v.）茁壯成長
~原文 Palm trees thrive in tropical climates; they don't grow well in cold places.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tom fell down the stairs and had many ______ on his face.
A: bruises
B: cores
C: rims
D: spines
= A
~詞義 bruise（n.）瘀傷
~原文 Tom fell down the stairs and had many bruises on his face.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Some people struggle to grasp the ______ of the universe because it is hard for them to imagine limitless space.
A: foul
B: infinity
C: coordinate
D: browser
= B
~詞義 infinity（n.）無限
~原文 Some people struggle to grasp the infinity of the universe because it is hard for them to imagine limitless space.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The museum ______ visitors from touching the artworks to prevent any accidental damage.
A: asserts
B: overturns
C: prohibits
D: withers
= C
~詞義 prohibit（v.）禁止
~原文 The museum prohibits visitors from touching the artworks to prevent any accidental damage.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Forcing workers to work under poor conditions and paying them low wages is little better than ______.
A: array
B: coverage
C: monopoly
D: slavery
= D
~詞義 slavery（n.）奴役
~原文 Forcing workers to work under poor conditions and paying them low wages is little better than slavery.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The environmentalists are protesting against the building of a factory in this region. They want to save the ______ from pollution.
A: exploration
B: ecosystem
C: presidency
D: transmission
= B
~詞義 ecosystem（n.）生態系統
~原文 The environmentalists are protesting against the building of a factory in this region. They want to save the ecosystem from pollution.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: lest
B: presidential
C: browsed
D: sowed
E: stereotype
F: nowhere

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: A ______ election takes place every four years, and the elected person can stay in office for no more than two terms.
= B
~詞義 presidential（adj.）總統的
~原文 A presidential election takes place every four years, and the elected person can stay in office for no more than two terms.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The farmer ______ corn seeds in the field, and the plants grew quickly after the spring rain.
= D
~詞義 sow（v.）將…種在某處
~原文 The farmer sowed corn seeds in the field, and the plants grew quickly after the spring rain.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: I remember bringing the key this morning, but now it is ______ to be found.
= F
~詞義 nowhere（adv.）無處
~原文 I remember bringing the key this morning, but now it is nowhere to be found.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is an outdated gender ______ that women should do all the housework while men go out to earn money.
= E
~詞義 stereotype（n.）刻板印象
~原文 It is an outdated gender stereotype that women should do all the housework while men go out to earn money.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The mother tiptoed toward the door ______ she wake the sleeping baby.
= A
~詞義 lest（conj.）以免
~原文 The mother tiptoed toward the door lest she wake the sleeping baby.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: currencies
B: whined
C: viable
D: undertook
E: extinct
F: productivity

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Terry presented a plan to the manager, but she doesn't consider it a(n) ______ plan.
= C
~詞義 viable（adj.）可實行的
~原文 Terry presented a plan to the manager, but she doesn't consider it a(n) viable plan.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: More and more people are investing in digital ______ even though they are a very risky form of investment.
= A
~詞義 currency（n.）貨幣
~原文 More and more people are investing in digital currencies even though they are a very risky form of investment.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The dodo, a bird from the island of Mauritius, which is east of Madagascar, went ______ in the seventeenth century due to hunting by the Dutch.
= E
~詞義 extinct（adj.）絕種的
~原文 The dodo, a bird from the island of Mauritius, which is east of Madagascar, went extinct in the seventeenth century due to hunting by the Dutch.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tina ______ to check her younger brother's homework, even though she had a demanding schedule.
= D
~詞義 undertake（v.）承諾
~原文 Tina undertook to check her younger brother's homework, even though she had a demanding schedule.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The poor cat had been starving for days, and it ______ at those who walked past.
= B
~詞義 whine（v.）哀鳴
~原文 The poor cat had been starving for days, and it whined at those who walked past.
